source: R2, Rollercoaster. speed_px_s is the car's speed along the track; orbit_ms is one lap of a card at a station; draw_ms is the time the track takes to draw to the next card; dwell_ms (the law's reading pause is 2200) covers the orbit, the draw and a rest. camera_line is where the car sits in the window (0 top, 1 bottom). Every value the ride uses is here.
